items.text: the picture's automation presets (Breathe, Drift, Slow turn…) are a row of pills that scrolls sideways, so the sliders they set stay on the screen; the lit one is what the sliders hold now

the small words under the bar (video under capture, mic under the speaker) carry their own ground in the bar's colours, so they read on any stage in light or dark, and step aside from a badge instead of printing over it
Room and Audience wear the open padlock at the end of their names in the index: both are Pro features, open to everyone in the beta
Audience is a Pro feature of its own, open to everyone in the beta (the open padlock on Let the audience in); joining from a phone stays free

Audience, in the index after Room. Let the audience in and the stage shows a code; phones scan it and every finger on every phone pulls the current, in that phone's color. With Water on, each phone plays the water sound it picked (drop, bubbles, whale, porpoise, gull) through this computer's speakers. Close the doors, lift every finger, push instead of pull, and cap how many phones. For now a rehearsal: phone windows on this computer (a phone window opens one), until the audience relay goes online
saving a long video on a phone could reload the page: the player now lets go of the clip while the share sheet reads it
sticker words on a phone: Text opens its box at once (in a moving sticker's share sheet too), and the keyboard stays while the sticker is made again around your typing
a walked path's tick on the tools shelf is the tiny tick in its small ring, not a big check over a dark disc
on a phone the dice shelf swipes all the way to the pair of dice, past the longest Fibonacci and prime counts
a scene's own crossfade (30 s) stays on one line, and a tapped button in the list no longer stays grey
